turn_prompts: Start a new fenced authoring conversation, read the prior snapshot and typed findings, and write only the fixed candidate files. When the frozen VerificationContract invokes test.sh through sh, both test.sh and solution/solve.sh must be POSIX sh compatible: do not use set -o pipefail, bash arrays, [[, or other Bash-only syntax.

Call harbor_validate_candidate after each repair. A rejection returns only bounded structured diagnostics; a pass captures the immutable replacement snapshot and validation receipt. At most two candidate validations are allowed.
